"""Version an unused verifier revision and preserve both preparation receipts."""
import ast
import hashlib
from pathlib import Path
from train_directional_bank_trial import read,ref,save
repo=Path('/home/dllu/proj/demosaic');root=repo/'.cache/quality-20261107/V165-pair-common-v1'
old=repo/'.cache/verify-v165-publication-v1.py';new=repo/'.cache/verify-v165-publication-v2.py';assert not new.exists()
changed=old.read_text();new.write_text(changed)
# Reconstruct the exact first unused verifier from its frozen deterministic preparer.
preparer=repo/'.cache/prepare-v165-publication-v1.py';source=preparer.read_text();tree=ast.parse(source)
generated={}
def capture(name,text):generated[name]=text
nodes=[]
for node in tree.body:
 if isinstance(node,ast.FunctionDef) and node.name=='write':continue
 if isinstance(node,ast.Expr) and isinstance(node.value,ast.Call) and isinstance(node.value.func,ast.Name) and node.value.func.id in ['save','print']:continue
 nodes.append(node)
exec(compile(ast.Module(body=nodes,type_ignores=[]),str(preparer),'exec'),{'__name__':'frozen_reconstruction','write':capture})
original=generated['verify-v165-publication-v1.py']
expected=next(v['sha256'] for v in read(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json')['sources'] if v['path']==str(old))
assert hashlib.sha256(original.encode()).hexdigest()==expected
old.write_text(original);assert ref(old)['sha256']==expected
# The old unused publisher and preparation remain unchanged; the new publisher selects v2.
publisher_old=repo/'.cache/publish-v165-final-v1.py';publisher=repo/'.cache/publish-v165-final-v2.py';assert not publisher.exists()
s=publisher_old.read_text().replace("'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json'", "'publication-helper-preparation-v2.json'")
s=s.replace("'verify-v165-publication-v1.py'", "'verify-v165-publication-v2.py'")
s=s.replace("'prepare-v165-report-builder-v1.py'", "'prepare-v165-report-builder-v1.py','correct-v165-publication-bindings-v2.py'")
s=s.replace("'publication-helper-preparation.json':'publication-helper-preparation-v2.json'", "'publication-helper-preparation.json':'publication-helper-preparation-v2.json','publication-binding-correction.json':'publication-binding-correction-v2.json'")
ast.parse(s);publisher.write_text(s)
paths=[Path(v['path']) for v in read(root/'final-helper-preparation-v1.json')['sources']]
paths += [repo/'.cache/finish-v165-execution-v1.py',publisher,new,repo/'.cache/build-v165-final-report-v1.py'];assert len(paths)==14
save(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v2.json',{'status':'fixed-final-accounting-and-versioned-publication-bindings-before-quality',
 'sources':[ref(p) for p in paths[10:13]],'supersedes':ref(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json'),
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
correction={'status':'corrected-unused-publication-helper-binding-without-scientific-work',
 'reason':'The report-layout preparer added independent unit-group verification after the first publication-helper receipt had bound verifier-v1. Preserve the exact original verifier-v1 and receipt; retain the revised bytes as verifier-v2 and publish through a new publisher-v2. The v1 layout receipt still preserves the revision text and is explicitly superseded.',
 'original_verifier':ref(old),'revised_verifier':ref(new),'original_publication_preparation':ref(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json'),
 'superseded_layout':ref(root/'final-layout-preparation-v1.json'),'superseded_public_layout':ref(repo/'docs/results/v165-publication-layout-preparation-v1.json'),
 'new_publisher':ref(publisher),'new_preparation':ref(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v2.json'),
 'source':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),'scientific_workers_affected':0,'scientific_calls_repeated':0,'new_forwards':0}
save(root/'publication-binding-correction-v2.json',correction)
for v in read(root/'publication-helper-preparation-v1.json')['sources']:assert ref(v['path'])==v
save(root/'final-layout-preparation-v2.json',{'status':'fixed-full-publication-layout-before-quality-with-explicit-versioned-binding-correction',
 'sources':[ref(p) for p in paths],'supersedes':ref(root/'final-layout-preparation-v1.json'),
 'correction':ref(root/'publication-binding-correction-v2.json'),'rounded_cells':273,'objective_group_integer_cells':60,'unit_group_count_cells':6,
 'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0})
public=repo/'docs/results/v165-publication-layout-preparation-v2.json';assert not public.exists()
save(public,{'status':'fixed-before-trained-quality-explicit-versioned-correction','layout':ref(root/'final-layout-preparation-v2.json'),
 'supersedes':ref(repo/'docs/results/v165-publication-layout-preparation-v1.json'),'correction':correction,
 'source_texts':[dict(ref(p),text=p.read_text()) for p in paths],'corrector':dict(ref(Path(__file__)),text=Path(__file__).read_text()),
 'new_forwards':0,'new_noise_draws':0,'expected_main_owners':10,'expected_total_owners':11,'expected_root_calls':5376,
 'expected_head_images':11472,'rounded_cells':273,'objective_integer_cells':60,'unit_group_count_cells':6,
 'scope':'Original v1 sources/receipts preserved. Use publisher-v2 and verifier-v2;finish-v1 and report-builder-v1 remain exact. No scientific job failed,restarted or repeated. Actual notes require audit pass and all72 original-detail views.'})
print('Restored exact original verifier-v1;retained revised verifier-v2 and publisher-v2;preserved v1 receipts and emitted explicit v2 correction')
